### Four Trumpets of Judgment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/four-trumpets-of-judgment
Passage: Revelation 8:6-13
Points:
- Trumpet blasts echo Old Testament warnings of divine judgment arriving to defeat God's enemies.
- The plagues of the first four trumpets parallel the Exodus judgments against Egypt's oppressive empire.
- The imagery depicts common ancient warfare realities, showing that mighty worldly powers remain fragile and vulnerable.
- These visions offer repeated perspectives on judgment rather than a rigid chronological timeline of events.
- Christians can take comfort in God's ultimate victory, wielding persistent prayer as their greatest weapon.
